subject: Intro: QuickCart demo intake — traffic profile & timeline
messages:
From: Samir Shah <samir@quickcart.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Demo request — QuickCart signup (self-serve)

Hi Monica,

We just signed up for Redwood’s self-serve plan last week and I wanted to get a short walkthrough to understand how we’d set up model routing and batch sizing for our use case. Quick background: we run QuickCart (marketplace for local grocers). Primary ask is a search-driven recommendations API + conversational support for shoppers. Current profile: ~300k monthly API requests today, aiming for a pilot that handles 1–2M monthly requests (peak ~1200 rps during promotions).

We’d like to see a demo that covers: model choices for recommendation vs. chat, latency & cost tradeoffs, and an overview of batching/caching options. Timeline: hoping to pilot in Q3 and go to production Q4.

Are you available for a 30–45m session next week? We’re in US Pacific (PST). Preferred windows: Tue/Wed mornings (9–11am PT) or Thu afternoon (1–3pm PT).

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Shah
Head of ML, QuickCart

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@quickcart.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — QuickCart signup (self-serve)

Hi Samir — welcome and thanks for signing up. I’ve looped in Ben (SDR) and Marissa (Solutions) so they can join the session. A few quick qualification items so we tailor the demo: 

- Primary surface: is the demo mainly for "search -> ranked recommendations" or for "chat/assist" (or both)?
- Latency SLOs you care about (p95/p99 targets)?
- Do you have any regulatory/region constraints (EU personal data, PCI concerns)?
- Volume breakdown: percent real-time chat vs. batch/rerank workloads (ballpark is fine).
- Pilot goals: success metrics for Q3 pilot (e.g., CTR uplift, latency, cost per request).

If you can share a quick traffic snapshot (e.g., last 30 days), that will help Ben and Marissa recommend a starting config.

Proposed demo slots (PST):
- Tue 2027-04-27 09:30–10:15
- Wed 2027-04-28 10:00–10:45
- Thu 2027-04-29 13:30–14:15

If none of the above work, tell us 2–3 windows that do and we’ll adapt. We can also do a shorter 20m focused call if you prefer.

Link to quickstart guide (for your team to peek before the call): https://redwood.com/docs/quickstart

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morales <elena@quickcart.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-25T10:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request — QuickCart signup (self-serve)

Hi Monica (and team),

Thanks — quick answers below and I attached the traffic snapshot CSV.

- Use case: both search/ranking (primary) and shopper chat (secondary). Most traffic is search/rank (~80%), chat is ~20% but chat sessions are longer.
- Latency targets: p95 < 250ms for ranking calls; p95 < 500ms for chat responses. p99 goals are less strict initially.
- Compliance: US-only for now. No PCI-scope data in requests; we tokenize payment info elsewhere.
- Volume split: out of current 300k monthly requests, ~240k ranking and ~60k chat. For pilot we expect 1–2M requests with similar split; spikes up to ~1k–1.2k rps during big promos.
- Pilot success metrics: maintain p95 SLOs while keeping cost per 1k requests under our target (TBD in call).

Available times (PST): Wed 2027-04-28 10:00–10:45 (works great) or Thu 2027-04-29 14:00–14:45. I booked the Wed slot tentatively for 10:00.

Attaching: QuickCart_traffic_snapshot.csv

Best,
Elena
Elena Morales
Technical Program Manager, QuickCart
